summary.es: Deja de buscar televisores e impresoras sin parar.
summary.en: Stops constantly looking for TVs and printers.

details.es: SSDP y el host UPnP buscan televisores, impresoras y NAS en tu red sin parar. Si no compartes nada en la red de casa, sobran. El UPnP de los juegos (abrir puertos del router) no depende de ellos.
details.en: SSDP and the UPnP host keep scanning your network for TVs, printers and NAS boxes. If you don't share anything on your home network, you don't need them. Game UPnP (opening router ports) doesn't depend on them.
